lines.text: Many learners say: This water has gift in it.
Better: This water has poison in it.
Poison! It has poison in it.

data.wrong: This water has gift in it.
data.right: This water has poison in it.

quiz.stem: Do not drink it. It has ___ in it.

native.tip: Das englische „gift“ ist ein Geschenk. Gift im Wasser heißt „poison“.
native.caption: Das Wort „gift“ sieht vertraut aus, aber Vorsicht! 🎁 “Gift” heißt Geschenk. Falsch: “This water has gift in it.” Richtig: “This water has poison in it.” Hör Carlos zu und sprich nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.

en.hook: The word “gift” looks familiar, but be careful!
en.tip: The English “gift” is a present. Poison in the water is “poison”.
en.caption: “Gift” means Geschenk in English, not the German Gift. Wrong: “This water has gift in it.” Right: “This water has poison in it.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
